newsitem.title: USA: Storm off New Caledonia still threatens ships - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Storm off New Caledonia still threatens ships - WSC.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Drena is expected to weaken gradually over the next 48 hours as the system tracks southeastward in the Coral Sea, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Tuesday.
But the system will continue to threaten shipping.
Drena, located near 19s/161e, will track just southwest of New Caledonia, paralleling the southwest coast.
It is a dangerous storm with maximum sustained winds of 120 mph, and locally heavy rains and a very heavy surf are expected along the coast.
